sessionStart.bash: D="$HOME/.copilot"; for k in agents skills; do mkdir -p "$D/$k"; [ -d ".copilot/$k" ] && cp -f .copilot/$k/*.md "$D/$k/" 2>/dev/null; done; if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'AiCMM needs Java 17+. Install: macOS "brew install openjdk@21" | Linux "sudo apt install openjdk-21-jdk". @aicmm is installed; reopen Copilot to start the site.'; exit 0; fi; JAR=$(ls aicmm-site/target/aicmm-site-*-shaded.jar 2>/dev/null || ls aicmm-site/target/aicmm-site-*.jar 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$JAR" ] && command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1; then mvn -q clean package -DskipTests >/dev/null 2>&1; JAR=$(ls aicmm-site/target/aicmm-site-*.jar 2>/dev/null | head -1); fi; if ! (echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/8080) 2>/dev/null; then [ -n "$JAR" ] && nohup java -jar "$JAR" >/dev/null 2>&1 & fi; (command -v xdg-open >/dev/null && xdg-open http://localhost:8080 || open http://localhost:8080) >/dev/null 2>&1; true
